title.narrative: Promoting Circularity in the Tamil Nadu leather clusters for solid waste management

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to promote circular market-based models for processing solid waste generated from leather tanning and finishing practices in at least 4 Tamil Nadu leather clusters. This will be achieved by introducing improved tanning and waste treatment practices and technologies and by creating the capacities and conditions among SME tanneries and their industry partners for the wide scale adoption. The main incentive for SME tanneries to adopt the circular tanning and leather finishing practices is linked to the value creation from solid waste, which provides a source of additional income. The support of Government of Tamil Nadu will facilitate the adoption of these circular tanning and leather finishing practices, which is required to achieve the following key project impact:a)Reduced amount of solid waste that ends up in the open spaces/landfills.b)Improved public health situation for workers and people living near leather clusters in Tamil Nadu.c)Enhanced international competitiveness and market access of leather export from Tamil Nadu.
